text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Overdoses up to 31,500 mg of atovaquone have been reported. In one patient who also took an unspecified dose of dapsone, methemoglobinemia occurred. Rash has also been reported after overdose. There is no known antidote for atovaquone, and it is currently unknown if atovaquone is dialyzable.
